English Wizard.question:
Transform the following sentences as directed.
১) In 1980s, Maradona was the most popular footballer in the world. (Positive).
English Wizard.option1: ক) In 1980s, very few footballers in the world were as popular as Maradona.
English Wizard.option2: খ) In 1980s, no other footballer in the world was as popular as Maradona.
English Wizard.option3: গ) In 1980s, Maradona was more popular than any other footballer in the world.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) In 1980s, no other footballers in the world were as popular as Maradona.
English Wizard.exp:
Comparative / Superlative কে Positive করতে হলে চারটি কাজ করতে হয়:
1. Subject- Predicate হয়, Predicate - Subject হয়
2. Affirmative -Negative হয়, Negative Affirmative হয়
3. Degree change হয়
4. Indicator (the/ than--> so...as, as...as) Change হয়
Structure: One of the ছাড়া শুধু Superlative Degree থাকলে :- No other+ Predicate অংশের Noun+ Verb+ as/ so + Positive Degree+ as + Subject
নিয়ম/ Structure অনুযায়ী খ সঠিক।

English Wizard.question: ২) The slaughtering of the monster was one of the toughest jobs that he performed. (positive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) No other job that he performed was as tough as the slaughtering of the monster.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Very few job that he performed was as tough as the slaughtering of the monster.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Very few jobs that he performed were as tough as the slaughtering of the monster.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The slaughtering of the monster was as tough as other jobs that he performed.
English Wizard.exp: One of the থাকলে Positive করার গঠন হচ্ছে Very few+ positive degree এর পরের Plural Noun + Plural Verb+ as/so + Positive Degree+ as +Superlative Degree এর Subject

English Wizard.question: ৩) Mitul is as diligent as Ratul. (Comparative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Ratul is not more diligent than Mitul.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Mitul is not more diligent than Ratul.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Ratul is not less diligent than Mitul.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Mitul is more diligent than Ratul.
English Wizard.exp:
এ রকম বাক্যের প্রেক্ষাপটটা এরকম যে, কেউ রাতুলের পক্ষ নিয়ে মিতুলের ব্যাপারে আপত্তি করল, তখন অন্যজন বলল, মিতুল রাতুলের মতই পরিশ্রমী এ অবস্থায় এর সঠিক Comparative ২ভাবে হতে পারে।
Ratul is not more diligent than Mitul. (More বললে Subject এর অবস্থান পরিবর্তন হবে)
Mitul is not less diligent than Ratul. (less বললে Subject এর অবস্থান পরিবর্তন হবে না)

English Wizard.question: ৪) According to the story, no other man in the village was as wise as Nambi. (Superlative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) According to the story, Nambi was wisest man in the village.
English Wizard.option2: খ) According to the story, Nambi was one of the wisest man in the village.
English Wizard.option3: গ) According to the story, Nambi was the wisest man in the village.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) According to the story, no other man was as wisest as Nambi.
English Wizard.exp: No other থাকলে Superlative করতে হলে the+ superlative degree বসে। এর পাশাপাশি Subject- Predicate এবং Predicate- Subject হয়ে বসে।

English Wizard.question: ৫) No other virtue in a man’s life is as important as honesty. (Comparative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Honesty is the most important virtue in a man’s life.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Honesty is more important than any other virtues in a man’s life.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Honesty is more important than many other virtues in a man’s life.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Honesty is more important than all other virtues in a man’s life.
English Wizard.exp: No other থাকলে Comparative করতে হলে than any other+ Singular Noun অথবা than all other+ Plural Noun বসে।

English Wizard.question: ৬) A contented poor man is happier than a greedy rich man. (positive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) A contented poor man is as happy as a greedy rich man.
English Wizard.option2: খ) A greedy rich man is not so happy as a contented poor man.
English Wizard.option3: গ) A greedy rich man is not less happy as a contented poor man.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) A contented poor man is not as happy as a greedy rich man.
English Wizard.exp:
Comparative / Superlative কে Positive করতে হলে চারটি কাজ করতে হয়:
1. Subject- Predicate হয়, Predicate - Subject হয়
2. Affirmative -Negative হয়, Negative- Affirmative হয়
3. Degree change হয়
4. Indicator Change হয় (than/ the --> as... as/ so....as)

English Wizard.question: ৭) She feels that her father is better than all other fathers in the world. (Superlative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) She feels that her father is the best fathers in the world.
English Wizard.option2: খ) She feels that her father is one of the best fathers in the world.
English Wizard.option3: গ) She feels that no other father is the best father in the world as her father.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) She feels that her father is the best father in the world.
English Wizard.exp: than all other/ than any other থাকলে the+ Superlative Degree+ Singular Noun বসে।

English Wizard.question: ৮) Jamil was one of the sincerest students that we have ever known. (Positive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) No other students that we have ever known was as sincere as Jamil.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Very few student that we have ever known was as sincere as Jamil.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Very few students that we have ever known were as sincere as Jamil.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Jamil was as sincere as other students that we have ever known.
English Wizard.exp: One of the থাকলে Positive করার গঠন হচ্ছে Very few+ superlative degree এর পরের Plural Noun + Plural Verb+ as/so + Positive Degree+ as +Subject of Superlative Degree.

English Wizard.question: ৯) Bangladesh is now one of the strongest teams in the one-day cricket. (Comparative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Very few teams in the one-day cricket are as stronger as Bangladesh.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Bangladesh is stronger than many other teams in the one-day cricket.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Bangladesh is stronger than any other teams in the one-day cricket.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Bangladesh is stronger than all other teams in the one-day cricket.
English Wizard.exp: One of the থাকলে Comparative করার সময় than many other + Plural Noun অথবা than most other + Plural Noun বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১০) Very few persons were as vindictive as Iago. (Superlative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Iago is one of the most vindictive persons.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Iago was the most vindictive persons.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Iago was one of the most vindictive person.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Iago was one of the most vindictive persons.
English Wizard.exp:
Very few থাকলে- Superlative করার সময়-
1. Subject- predicate এবং Predicate – Subject হয়।
2. one of the +Superlative degree + Plural noun বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১১) Joseph is as disciplined as Tom. (Comparative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Tom is more disciplined than Joseph.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Joseph is not less disciplined than Tom.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Joseph is less disciplined than Tom.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Tom is not less disciplined than Joseph.
English Wizard.exp:
Positive কে Comparative করতে হলে চারটি কাজ করতে হয়:
1. Subject- Predicate হয়, Predicate - Subject হয়
2. Affirmative -Negative হয়, Negative Affirmative হয়
3. Degree change হয়
4. Indicator Change হয় (as... as/ so....as --> than/ the)
এ হিসাবে সঠিক উত্তর : Tom is not more industrious than Joseph.

অথবা ২য় পদ্ধতি হচ্ছে- 1 no কাজ (Subject- Predicate এর অবস্থান পরিবর্তন) না করে
less+Positive Degree দিয়ে Comparative Degree গঠন করা এবং বাকী কাজগুলো করা।
যেমন- Joseph is not less industrious than Tom.

English Wizard.question: ১২) I have been reading the book for two hours. (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) The book have been being read for two hours by me.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The book has been being read by me for two hours.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The book has been read for two hours by me.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) This sentence has no passive form
English Wizard.exp:
একই সাথে been এবং being ইংরেজি বাক্যে বসানোর নিয়ম নেই।
যেমন - সে তিন দিন ধরে অসুস্থ = He has been ill for three days.
কিন্তু নিয়ম অনুযায়ী এখানে Period of Time উল্লেখ থাকায় Perfect Continuous Tense হিসেবে He has been being ill for three days হওয়া উচিত ছিল।
আর এ নিয়ম অনুযায়ীই Perfect Continuous Tense এর Passive Voice এ being অতিরিক্ত ব্যবহৃত হয় না, শুধু Verb+ ing এর পরিবর্তে মূল Verb এর Past Participle বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১৩) Green mangoes taste sour. (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Green mangoes are sour if it is tasted.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Green mangoes are sour when its are tasted.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Green mangoes are sour when those are tasted.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Green mangoes are sour when they are tasted.
English Wizard.exp: Green mangoes – plural হওয়ায় এর পরিবর্তে Plural Pronoun they বসবে । Those – plural হলেও এটি ইঙ্গিতসূচক Pronoun হিসেবে শুধু নির্দিষ্ট Noun এর পরিবর্তে বসে। কিন্তু এখানে green mangoes সাধারণ বা অনির্দিষ্ট। তাই এখানে একমাত্র সঠিক উত্তর ঘ।

English Wizard.question: ১৪) When I saw him, he told me the fact. (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) When he was seen by me, he told me the fact.
English Wizard.option2: খ) When he was seen by me, I was told by him the fact.
English Wizard.option3: গ) When he was seen by me, I was told the fact by him.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) When I saw him, the fact was told me by him.
English Wizard.exp:
ক, ঘ - Complex Sentence এ উভয় Clause কেই Passive করতে হয়।
খ- Object সব সময় Verb এর ঠিক পরপর বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১৫) He annoyed me. (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) I was annoyed with him.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I was annoyed at him.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I was annoyed by him.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I was annoyed for him.
English Wizard.exp: Passive Voice এ annoyed এর পর ব্যক্তির পূর্বে with বসে আর বস্তুর পূর্বে at বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১৬) Evil thoughts made up his mind. (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) His mind was made up by evil thoughts.
English Wizard.option2: খ) His mind was made up with evil thoughts.
English Wizard.option3: গ) His mind was made up of evil thoughts.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) His mind was made up from evil thoughts.
English Wizard.exp: Passive Voice এ made up এর পর of বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১৭) One can achieve success by one’s sincere efforts. (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Success can be achieved by sincere efforts.
English Wizard.option2: খ) One’s sincere efforts can be achieved by one.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Sincere efforts can be achieved in success.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) One’s success can achieved by one’s sincere efforts.
English Wizard.exp: Active Voice এ Subject হিসেবে one থাকলে Passive Voice এ এটা উল্লেখ করার প্রয়োজন নেই।

English Wizard.question: ১৮) It is impossible to do this. (Make it passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Doing this is impossible.
English Wizard.option2: খ) This is impossible to be done.
English Wizard.option3: গ) This can't be done.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) It is done impossible.
English Wizard.exp:
• এই কাঠামো যুক্ত passive voice-এর ক্ষেত্রে সাধারণ নিয়ম ব্যবহার করা হয় না। 
- এগুলো একটু ব্যতিক্রম নিয়মে passive voice করতে হয়।

• এটা ভাবার্থের বিচারে Passive Voice করতে হবে। 
- This is impossible to be done. সঠিক মনে হলেও সঠিক নয়। 
- কারণ নিয়মানুযায়ী Adjective (Impossible) এর পর Passive Form এ কখনো infinitive to বসে না।
- তাই সঠিক উত্তর হবে - This can't be done.

English Wizard.question: ১৯) Oppression and suppression made them look older. (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) They were made to be looked older by oppression and suppression.
English Wizard.option2: খ) They made to be looked older by oppression and suppression.
English Wizard.option3: গ) They were made look older by oppression and suppression.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) They were made to look older by oppression and suppression.
English Wizard.exp: Make এর পর Bare Infinitive (উহ্য to) Active Voice এ হলেও, Passive Voice এ to যোগ করতে হয়। আর একই Clause এর মধ্যে দুইবার Passive হয় না। এ হিসেবে কেবল ঘ সঠিক।

English Wizard.question: ২০) Bad temper should be controlled for our own sake. (Active)
English Wizard.option1: ক) People should control bad temper for our own sake.
English Wizard.option2: খ) We should be control bad temper for our own sake.
English Wizard.option3: গ) We should control bad temper for our own sake.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) We should controlled bad temper for our own sake.
English Wizard.exp: এখানে Subject নেই, যেহেতু পরবর্তীতে our আছে তাই এখানে Subject – we হবে।

English Wizard.question: ২১) The ancient mariner was watching the water snakes swimming round the ship. (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) The water snakes was being watched swimming round the ship by the ancient mariner .
English Wizard.option2: খ) The water snakes were being watched swimming round the ship by the ancient mariner.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The water snakes were watched swimming round the ship by the ancient mariner.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The water snakes were being watched by the ancient mariner swimming round the ship.
English Wizard.exp:
Sub+ Verb+ Obj এর পরের Verb+ing (Participle) যেভাবে আছে সেভাবেই থাকবে। এখানে মূল অংশ The ancient mariner was watching the water snakes. অতএব, অন্যদিকে মনোযোগ না দিয়ে এ অংশের উপর ফোকাস করুন।
by the old mariner শেষে বসবে। ঘ- এর অর্থ হবে ancient mariner ই সাঁতাররত অবস্থায় ছিল।

English Wizard.question: ২২) Don’t look down upon the poor. (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) The poor is not looked down upon.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The poor are not looked down upon.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Let the poor be not looked down upon.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Let not the poor be looked down upon.
English Wizard.exp: Imperative sentence কে Passive করতে হলে বাক্যের প্রথমে let বসাতে হয়। Negative বাক্যে Subject – noun হলে not – Noun এর পূর্বে বসে।

English Wizard.question: ২৩) What helps the pious remain contented? (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) What are the pious helped to remain contented?
English Wizard.option2: খ) By what is the pious helped to remain contented?
English Wizard.option3: গ) By what are the pious helped to remain contented?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) By what were the pious helped to remain contented?
English Wizard.exp:
Active Voice এ What Subject হলে Passive voice এ by what বসে।
Wh Words (who, what ইত্যাদি) ছাড়া অন্য কিছু Subject হলে Interrogative Sentence এ Auxiliary Verb – Subject এর পূর্বে বসে।

English Wizard.question: ২৪) What has been expected by the poor from the rich? (Active)
English Wizard.option1: ক) What the poor have expected from the rich?
English Wizard.option2: খ) What has the poor expected from the rich?
English Wizard.option3: গ) What have the poor expected from the rich?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) By what have the poor expected from the rich?
English Wizard.exp:
Adjective এর আগে the থাকলে ( the poor) তা Plural Common Noun হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়।
Wh Words (who, what ইত্যাদি) ছাড়া অন্য কিছু Subject হলে Interrogative Sentence এ Auxiliary Verb – Subject এর পূর্বে বসে।

English Wizard.question: ২৫) Wasn’t this man leading a great people? (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Wasn’t a great people being led by this man?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Weren’t a great people being led by this man?
English Wizard.option3: গ) Didn’t a great people being led by this man?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Wasn’t a great people led by this man?
English Wizard.exp: people অর্থ এখানে জাতি। তাই এটা Singular.
